part.text:
Fixed the result-level cache restore bug in `ResultRow.populateFromCache` (`processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/groupby/ResultRow.java:179`): the post-aggregator index and iterator now advance, so multiple post-aggregate values are restored into their correct positions instead of overwriting the first slot.

Validated with `GroupByQueryQueryToolChestTest` (20 passed) and `ResultRowTest` (2 passed).
